outcomeMap.condition: the after-tree equals expectedAfter outside ignoredPaths

outcomeMap.score: 0 to 999999, the locked evaluator's partial score or 0

outcomeMap.condition: the locked evaluator's GRADE decision record is in envelope ERROR (F2; GR-DECISION-RECORD-001): blockerCode EVALUATOR_ERROR, evidenceDigest that record's digest
an environment cause with its evidence; never entered into an evaluation record

fixtureLockRule: A run that is not fixture-backed (a recording run) sets locks.fixtureDigest to the RFC 8785 digest of the sorted array of its tasks' workspaceBefore tree digests, one per task (ORC-295-D1-ERRATUM); a fixture-backed run sets digest(F) (draft 3.4).

ruleFamilies.name: Trees and the path grammar (draft 3.1)
ruleFamilies.property: A tree is {entries: [{path, kind FILE|EXECUTABLE|SYMLINK, digest}]}, sorted by UTF-8 bytes; a path is relative, without empty, '.' or '..' segments, backslash or control characters, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes; no case-fold collision and no directory prefix; a SYMLINK target, read from the blob store by its digest, resolves lexically inside the tree to a FILE or EXECUTABLE entry.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 3.1; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: The fixture shape (draft 3.1)
ruleFamilies.property: replay-fixture/v1 is closed; requestMatch DIGEST, or INDEX with requestMatchReason; the generator is {id, version, digest}.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 3.1; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: Placement (draft 4.5, N5)
ruleFamilies.property: Fixtures in public files are DEVELOPMENT only; a HELD_OUT fixture document in a public store is refused. No HELD_OUT fixture is stored: the vector builds its document in memory.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 4.5; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: The trajectory (draft 3.2; R00's exit list)
ruleFamilies.property: replay-trajectory/v1 embeds the whole run manifest, checked by MAS-RA-002's model; steps 1..n, MODEL or TOOL, their bodies in the blob store under their bytesDigest; exit.code from the closed list of its status (EVALUATOR_ERROR is never a trajectory's).
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 3.2; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: Keyless replay (U1, draft 3.2)
ruleFamilies.property: MODEL steps are answered from the record; under DIGEST the first MODEL request that differs is REPLAY_DIVERGED and the replay stops, under INDEX only the tree check remains; TOOL steps are never compared; the trees pass the path grammar before anything is materialised.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 3.2 and 6; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: replay-verdict/v1 (Q-HRF-2 (a), draft 3.6)
ruleFamilies.property: verdict REPLAY_MATCH, REPLAY_DIVERGED or TREE_MISMATCH; divergedAtStep only for REPLAY_DIVERGED, and afterTreeDigest null exactly then.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 3.6; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: The scoring record (draft 3.3)
ruleFamilies.property: One replay-score/v1 per run: exactly the partition's tasks, each with its own fixture and trajectory, every trajectory embedding the scored manifest; scoredFrom TRACE; outcome and score by the exit-to-outcome map.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 3.3; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: Run lock binding (draft 3.4)
ruleFamilies.property: For a fixture-backed run, locks.fixtureDigest is digest(F), F the sorted unique per-task fixture digests, one per partition task; each result's fixture is in F and is its task's.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 3.4; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: Blocked results (draft 3.5, 4.3; F2's row)
ruleFamilies.property: BLOCKED is the environment's (one of four causes, with its evidence) or, after a COMPLETED run, the grader's (EVALUATOR_ERROR, its evidence the GRADE record in envelope ERROR); a run with a BLOCKED result never enters a MAS-RA-002 evaluation record.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 3.5 and 4.3; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: Regeneration (draft 4.4)
ruleFamilies.property: A fixture is rebuilt only by its pinned generator from its pinned trajectory and before-tree; a byte-equal rebuild keeps the id, any other is a new id that inherits nothing.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 4.4; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: Arm pairs (draft 4.2, 4.3; Q-HRF-3 (a))
ruleFamilies.property: arm-pair/v1 names its variable; the configuration tuple and the locks differ in exactly that field; a blocked task in either arm makes the state UNRESOLVED (WARN).
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 4.2 and 4.3; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

ruleFamilies.name: The denominator (draft 4.1, C-DENOM)
ruleFamilies.property: Every partition task counts in every run; ERRORED (with BUDGET_EXCEEDED) scores 0; a dropped repetition leaves MAS-RA-002's record incomplete.
ruleFamilies.source: R12 draft r4 b29de4be section 4.1; CONTRACT_295 r4 section 3b

settlements.text: The worked example has two runs (ORC-295-D1; R12's erratum 303b3941): the recording run M0 writes fx-dev-000N.t1, the fixtures are built from them, and the scored run M1 (locks.fixtureDigest = digest(F)) writes fx-dev-000N.r1, which its scoring record names. Draft r4's one-run binding had a digest cycle; no rule changes.
The exit-to-outcome map gains the grader-error row (COMPLETED, GRADE record in envelope ERROR: BLOCKED, 0, EVALUATOR_ERROR); a trajectory never carries EVALUATOR_ERROR.
REGENERATION_MISMATCH is a record refusal decided from the fixture, its trajectory and its before-tree; REPLAY_DIVERGED and TREE_MISMATCH are replay verdicts, never record refusals.

R00 sets the exit.code lists: COMPLETED DONE; ERRORED AGENT_ERROR, TOOL_ERROR, HARNESS_ERROR; BUDGET_EXCEEDED one per MAS-RA-002 budget field plus BUDGET_ITERATIONS (MAS-RA-008's loop bound); BLOCKED the four environment causes.
(a) home architecture/replay-fixtures/, an internal candidate beside run-manifest/.
(a) withhold: a pair is UNRESOLVED (WARN); a single record leaves the blocked run out.
(a) C-BLOCKED's pair rule has no named code: a pair whose blockedTasks or state does not follow it is MAS-RA-002's DECISION_MISMATCH (flagged for the c1 review).
(b) A SYMLINK target is read from the blob store by the entry's digest; a target that is missing is TREE_PATH (flagged for the c1 review).

A step blob missing from the store is MAS-RA-002's UNKNOWN_REFERENCE, a blob whose bytes are not its digest SHAPE; the pinned generator is fixture-builder 1, the model's build_fixture, and a fixture's generator digest is the model file's bytesDigest.
The worked split declares one synthetic HELD_OUT task by id and digest (MAS-RA-002 needs both partitions); no HELD_OUT fixture exists anywhere in public files.

outOfScope: Running a harness: the model replays against a recorded list of sent requests and a given after-tree.
